name: Slaughterhouse
title: Slaughterhouse
summary: A Tumerok fort 'specialized in processing bovine animals' (acpedia). It is a walled block of flat-roofed halls with stake palisades and one 31 m spire tower at its north-west corner, filling the floor of a V-shaped valley (z 80) whose walls rise to 150 m and close to a point 150 m south. Cows, aurochs and slabs of meat fill the yard, and a bench, an axe and a blood-stained block sit in the south pen. The valley opens north onto a broad flat.

shots.standingOrder: Pull straight back north-north-west and up from the slaughterhouse tower, 30 m to 88 m out and 10 m to 42 m high, until the walled pens fill the V of the valley; climb clear of the plain.
shots.notes: Dronie: the drone starts 30 m north-north-west of the slaughterhouse's 31 m spire tower, 10 m up. It flies back and up in one line to 88 m out and 42 m up. The walled Tumerok fort, its stake palisades and the cattle pens (cows, aurochs and slabs of meat in the yard) shrink into the V of a valley whose walls rise to 150 m. The west sun side-lights the tower from the right.
